title: Seeking Sources for Utility Energy Services Contract (UESC) at Fort Benning, Georgia
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.SCO ALEXANDRIA.SUPPORT CENTER HUNTSVILLE.W2V6 USA ENG SPT CTR HUNTSVIL
detail_text: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Huntsville Center (HNC) intends to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP) for energy management services. The purpose of this acquisition is to award Fort Benning, AL, a Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Utility Energy Services Contract (UESC) with a period of performance that shall not exceed 25 years. Please refer to the attached notice for more information.
